name: Relevance of EVEE Evo 2 embedding extraction compute (Pearce et al. 2026) to "Select an execution workflow for large-scale diagnostic genomics"
description: Proxy. name: Relevance of Fine-tuning and evaluation wall time, 5 epochs on the Enformer eQTL dataset (Hegde et al. 2025 Table A1) to "Select an execution workflow for large-scale diagnostic genomics"
description: Proxy. Wall time to adapt a genomic foundation model to a human non-coding variant classification task and to score a held-out set of 8,862 human variants, measured by a group that did not develop the model, with three seeds on one machine. It informs the compute a team needs to fine-tune and run such a model on its own hardware, but it is a research benchmark rather than a diagnostic workflow, and the table does not name its hardware.
